mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.message_id, c.citation_id, c.knowledge_id, c.index_version_id, c.document_id, c.document_version_id, c.generation_id, c.chunk_id, c.content_hash, c.title, c.title_path_json, c.locator_json, c.excerpt, c.create_time FROM chat_message_citation c INNER JOIN chat_message m ON m.id = c.message_id INNER JOIN chat_session s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE c.message_id = #{messageId} AND c.citation_id = #{citationId} AND s.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
